lesson: the ceiling crawl and the headfirst descent
link: the parts inside the toys come in by sea, from abroad, labelled "haberdashery".

keys.name: Silke's test: follow her across the cranes without touching the ground
keys.joke: She says one word all night. It's "Good."

keys.name: The bonded store: in the suit, inspect the "haberdashery" and get the customs officer to open it
keys.joke: He's never been asked to open anything. He cries a little.

keys.name: The records room: the manifests, from the ceiling, past the officers below
The auction: outbid a goon for a crate at the fish market
keys.joke: Nim wins the crate. It's actually fish.

keys.name: The searchlights: cross the Quay without being lit once
keys.joke: The last searchlight operator is asleep. Nim takes his flask.

keys.name: The engine room: shut the ship's engines from the pipes overhead
keys.joke: The engineer, bound, says he only works here for the pension.

keys.name: The bridge: pose as the harbour pilot and command the captain to stay at anchor
keys.joke: The captain is very relieved to be told what to do.

keys.name: The lighthouse: climb the outside in the storm
keys.joke: Vesper is dry. Nobody knows how.

keys.name: Five dockers woken
keys.joke: The last one looks at his pyramid of boxes and is quite proud of it, actually.

tin: the League's collection tin in the Customs House
people_in_trances: five dockers who opened a crate, stacking boxes in neat pyramids in the rain.
enemies: Goons: dock rats in oilskins. They fight, and they work the cranes.
Searchlights on the cranes and the ship, swept by a rat in each cab. Out of the light, she's unseen.
Gulls again, and now cormorants on the pilings, which dive at her if she's spotted.
Customs officers: stoats in uniform. Swyne pays them. They won't fight, but they blow whistles.

set_piece.name: The storm
set_piece.summary: The Prudence casts off early to get away with the cargo.
beats: Nim crosses from the Quay to the moving ship by rope, swinging from crane hook to crane hook as they swing in the wind.
On board, she climbs the mast and swings down rigging lines to cut each crate's net with a pounce, dropping the cargo into the harbour.
Searchlights sweep the deck. She hangs under the rails to stay out of them.
The tide drags the ship back. She drops anchor herself with a rope pull.
set_piece.punchline: the crates float. They all wash up on the Fish Market's slipway by morning, and the market sells them as "lace".

boss.name: Harbourmaster Mortimer Tusk
boss.summary: A walrus in an admiral's coat he wasn't issued. He fights in the Dry Dock, round a hull up on blocks.
phases: The crane. He swings containers at her from a crane cab. Nim ropes onto each container as it passes and rides it to the cab.
The flood. He opens the dock gates, and the dock floods fast. Nim crawls along pipes under the gantries, out of the water, to reach the gate controls.
The hull. He makes his stand on the hull's keel. She comes down the hull head first and pounces him.
boss.punchline: he's bound to the ship's own anchor, and the anchor is lowered, slowly, to a sensible depth for him to stand in.

leaves_with: The rope. The ceiling crawl and the headfirst descent.
The charts, which point to a wellness retreat in the hills, and the first look at the receivers.
Silke's verdict: nothing. She leaves her crane cab's key in Nim's hand.
owner_review: Every joke in the Key table, the names SS Prudence and Mortimer Tusk, and Vesper's and Silke's lines.
story: Coming in: Mrs. Gander's shipping notes name a ship, the SS Prudence, due in on tonight's tide. Silke has been watching the harbour for a week already. She doesn't say so; there's a sleeping bag on the crane.
The Docks: warehouses, cranes, rain, a fish market opening at four in the morning. Swyne's face is on a hoarding over the harbour: A DECENT PORT FOR A DECENT CITY.

Going out: the crates hold thousands of small brass coils marked with a spiral, the receivers. The ship leaves without its cargo. The harbour master's charts show where the coils go next: a wellness retreat in the hills.
Vesper watches from the top of the lighthouse.
how_it_teaches: Vesper's lesson: under the Quay's wharf, she hangs upside down from a beam by her feet, talking. Then she comes down a warehouse wall head first. Nim learns both: crawl along beams and pipes from beneath, and descend any climbable wall head first, which is faster and lands in a pounce.
Silke's rope after her test (Key 1): swing from rings and crane hooks, pull crates down, bind from a distance.
The suit at the docks: the Customs House and the fish market, posing as an inspector or a buyer.
notes: The harbour, at night, in a storm. It leans covert, and it's the most vertical world so far.
The map: a harbour with two quays, a breakwater and a lighthouse, and the Prudence in the middle of it.
